text:
Aisha: quick check before I merge the convo-schema PR — does anyone see a compatibility risk if we allow `role` to be nullable in streaming deltas? I'm trying to avoid having clients explode if they receive `null` for role.
Alex: our earlier notes said `role` should be optional on deltas (only present when it changes) but never `null`. nullable seems risky. can we send no `role` instead of `role: null`? :thinking_face:
Ben: runtime-wise we normalize missing role -> previous role. if clients get explicit `null` they'd need to handle it. runtime could coerce `null` -> "assistant" as a safety net but that's a bit hacky.
Chris: fyi streaming parser currently treats a `role` field even if null as a state update and resets internal role state — that can cause one-message role flips in long streams. I'll add a test for `role: null` to validate.
Aisha: ok — proposal: disallow `role: null` in the schema lint, but accept omitted `role`. if some producers accidentally send `null`, runtime will coerce to previous role for now and we mark it a producer bug. thoughts?
Dana: product note — we prefer minimal churn in the payload (fewer fields) for telemetry/cost. omitting fields is better than adding nullable fields.
schema-bot: lint-warning in convo-schema.json: line 42: `role` is defined as "string | null" — breaking-change-risk. Suggested fix: make `role` optional and update docs.
Ben: follow-up on toolcall payloads — PR currently allows `tool_call.params` as either string or object. that's fine but please document that string params will be treated as opaque and not parsed. also add a normalization example in the PR description: 
```json
{"delta": {"tool_call": {"name":"search","params":"q=hello"}}}
```
Alex: +1 on making `role` optional (not nullable). we should gate the lint rule behind the schema-shim feature flag for one release so older clients don't fail schema checks during rollout. :thumbsup:
Chris: I'll draft the parser fallback patch: treat `role: null` same as omitted, and log a single metric `stream.null_role_received` so we can track producers. will add a smoke test to eng-runtime.
Aisha: sounds good — Ben can you update the PR with the optional role change, feature-flag rollout notes, and add the example normalization? then I'll ping reviewers.
Ben: on it, will update the PR description and add the feature flag opt-in snippet. tagging @Chris for runtime follow-up and @Alex for final api review.
Alex: will take a look after lunch, if no objections let's merge with the opt-in flag and the migration test.
Aisha: thanks all — merging plan: opt-in flag -> two weeks of metric monitoring -> enable default. I'll leave the PR in draft until Chris posts the runtime smoke test.
Chris: will post a quick patch and a CI smoke test by EOD.
Dana: sweet, please add a short note in the release notes about the schema clarification so integrators know the recommended behavior.
Aisha: noted, will add a short blurb. thanks everyone.
